text: In Los Angeles, Frank and Lenore Davis await their second child, but the baby is born with fangs and claws, [kills the delivery room staff|threat|dangerous children] and escapes through a skylight. As it stalks the city, killing a milkman and a policeman, the press and police hound the family and Frank loses his job. A drug company suspects [Lenore's contraceptive pills|origin|monsters people made], Frank signs [papers letting researchers study the body|wrong|the powerful abuse their power], and Lenore [hides the infant in the basement|images|the house and its rooms].
